name: Cherish: A Memory Journal
description: CHERISH is a memory journal that contains sections to record all your precious moments, serving as living archives of your memories. It allows the past to unfold like an old photograph or letter—capturing the essence of where you've been and who you've become. With its thoughtful features, it makes for an exceptional family heirloom and a meaningful gift for generations to come.

segments.title: 75 Unique Prompt Stickers
segments.description: Inspiring questions to spark your memories and reflections. Personalize your journal with peel-and-stick prompts designed for maximum flexibility.

segments.title: Recipe Spreads
segments.description: A dedicated space to record family recipes or your own culinary adventures.

segments.title: Timeline Charts
segments.description: Organize milestones and memories visually with flexible and easy-to-use charts.

segments.title: Travel Maps
segments.description: Relive your travels and plan future adventures.

segments.title: Ruled & Blank Pages
segments.description: A set of ruled and blank pages to allow you to both script and draw with ease.

name: Celebrate: Day to Day Journal
description: The Celebrate Journal is a unique and versatile blank canvas that invites you to savor life's simple pleasures and celebrate the mundane moments that often go unnoticed. All pages are thoughtfully dotted, offering you the freedom to transform this journal into whatever inspires you—a scrapbook, a photography journal, or simply a place to put your thoughts on paper.

segments.description: Premium quality hardcover binding in matte finish.

segments.title: Luxurious Paper
segments.description: High-quality 100gsm acid-free paper for a luxurious writing experience.

segments.title: Smyth-Sewn Binding
segments.description: Smyth-sewn binding for durability and lay-flat convenience.

name: Create
description: In a world full of dreams, aspirations, and daily demands, the "Create" Planner stands as your trusted ally. It's a versatile tool designed to empower individuals from various walks of life—entrepreneurs with grand visions, students striving for academic excellence, or anyone on a journey of self-discovery.

segments.title: Brain Dump

segments.title: Habit Trackers
segments.description: Cultivate positive routines and monitor progress.

name: Indigo Chronicles: Set of 3 Journals
description: The Indigo Chronicles is a collection of three unique journals—Create, Cherish and Celebrate—crafted to cultivate personal growth and introspection. Perfect as a curated gift set, the Indigo Chronicles journals are a heartfelt present for loved ones, and invaluable tools for self-expression, reflection and recording memories.
